notablePrerequisites:
Thragtusk does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing Thragtusk.
Thragtusk dies, triggering its second ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Thragtusk trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Resolve the second Thragtusk trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Thragtusk enters the battlefield, causing you to gain five life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 1, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Beast token, putting a -1/-1 counter on Thragtusk and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
